query:
select
            c.id,
            c.email::text as "email!",
            coalesce(pr.navigateur, false) as "navigateur!",
            coalesce(pr.email_arrivee, false) as "email_arrivee!"
        from comptes c
        left join preferences_notification pr on pr.compte_id = c.id
        where c.role = 'mj'
